ms.promise:
Context: We are deploying Asterizm to enable cross-chain operations and the launch of cross-chain native (omnichain) tokens, which will attract more users, liquidity, and TVL to the Cardano ecosystem.
Task: Develop a set of Plutus smart contracts that implement Asterizm protocol
Outputs: A set of Plutus smart contracts
ms.criteria: A set of Plutus smart contracts and a description of their logical interconnections to facilitate transactions can be found in the repo
ms.report:
We have completed Milestone 2! The main script is located here:
・https://github.com/zkFold/zkfold-cardano/blob/main/zkfold-cardano-scripts/src/ZkFold/Cardano/UPLC/Asterizm.hs

We have already update the documentation how 3 contracts can be implemented with just a single Plutus script that enables the posting of signed messages on Cardano. This script will be used by both the relayer and the client servers:
・https://github.com/zkFold/project-catalyst-reports/blob/main/Asterizm/M1/zkFold%20x%20Asterizm%20-%20Interoperability%20Solution.pdf

It provides a very efficient way for posting verified signed messages on-chain. This script will be used by both clients and relayers. It is also general enough to cover sending messages both to and from Cardano. For example, to receive a message on Cardano with the Asterizm protocol, the relayer needs to post a signed message hash, while the client needs to post the signed message.

Outputs: Cardano integration into off-chain Relayer and Client software
ms.criteria:
・Provide a transaction which is the evidence of Cardano integration into off-chain Relayer and Client software can be found in the repo. 
・An updated documentation will include the overall architecture of how the components of Asterizm interact with each other and the Transaction Processing Logic that describes how transactions are processed in the system, from sending, receiving to validation.
ms.report:
The Asterizm <> Cardano integration has been completed and validated end-to-end. The relayer and client flows now support Cardano as part of the Asterizm cross-chain infrastructure, including message certification, incoming and outgoing message processing, message retrieval, unified client proof handling, trusted address validation, regular and Asterizm cross-chain hash modes, variable-length message headers, omni-token mint/burn flows, and reliable transaction submission.

 Public code and documentation evidence:
 - Asterizm integration CLI and end-to-end usage documentation:
 https://github.com/zkFold/zkfold-cardano/blob/main/e2e-test/asterizm/Asterizm.md
 - Integration implementation:
 https://github.com/zkFold/zkfold-cardano/tree/main/zkfold-cli/app/asterizm
 - Plutus policies used by the integration:
 https://github.com/zkFold/zkfold-cardano/blob/main/zkfold-cardano-scripts/src/ZkFold/Cardano/UPLC/Asterizm.hs
 - Reproducible E2E scripts:
 https://github.com/zkFold/zkfold-cardano/tree/main/e2e-test/asterizm

 Validation evidence:
 The completed integration was tested in both directions between BSC testnet and Cardano preprod.
